$description: COMPONENT tokens for Dialog. The backdrop tint is here rather than in the colour roles because it is the only place in the system that needs a translucent colour: everything else is opaque so its contrast can be asserted against a single number. A backdrop has nothing behind it worth asserting against, which is the exception that proves the rule.

default.$description: The page dimmed behind a modal. Translucent on purpose, and the one documented exception to the opaque-colour rule in COLOR.md.
512px. Wide enough for a paragraph and a form row, narrow enough that a line of text stays readable.
